mentions.name: TechnoJam
mentions.description: This app is a music-making DJ launchpad for kids 4+, with drums, bass, melody, and chord pads. Every tap is quantized to stay in scale, so children with zero music knowledge can have fun making electronic music. It contains no ads, subscriptions, or tracking, and works offline.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built TechnoJam (https://technojam.app), a music-making app for kids 4+. It’s a DJ launchpad (drums, bass, melody, chords) but every tap is quantized to stay in scale, so kids with zero music knowledge can have tons of fun making electronic music.
